### علم الجمال وفلسفة الفن

Groups: 3 · Skills: 11

[aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Aesthetic inquiry asks why experiences, works, and environments are judged beautiful, expressive, meaningful, or artistically valuable. Its focus is justification and concepts of value, not techniques of making art.

**User-friendly description (ar):** استكشف لماذا يعد الناس بعض التجارب والأعمال الفنية جميلة أو قيّمة.

**User-friendly description (ar):** اكتشف كيف يمكن دعم الآراء الجمالية بالأسباب والحجج.

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how setting, background knowledge, and cultural conventions can alter interpretation while the object remains unchanged.

[distinguishAestheticFromInstrumentalValue.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/aestheticJudgment/skills/distinguishAestheticFromInstrumentalValue.data.ts)

### نظرية المعرفة والتقييم النقدي

Groups: 4 · Skills: 19

[epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Questions about knowledge concern what can be believed responsibly, what makes claims true, and when confidence should change. This domain applies general standards of justification to testimony and public information; scientific experimental design has its own domain.

**User-friendly description (ar):** استكشف ما يجعل الاعتقاد مبررًا وكيفية تقييم المعلومات العامة.

#### الأدلة والشهادات

Skills: 5

[evidenceAndTestimony.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/evidenceAndTestimony.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Knowledge often depends on information supplied by other people or institutions. Source reliability, independence, and evidential fit require appraisal without treating every source as equally trustworthy.

**User-friendly description (ar):** تعلّم تقييم الادعاءات والأدلة التي ينقلها الآخرون.

##### تحليل الظلم المعرفي

[analyzeEpistemicInjustice.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/skills/analyzeEpistemicInjustice.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine how prejudicial credibility judgments or unequal interpretive resources can wrong someone in their capacity as a knower, distinct from warranted critical assessment of testimony.

**User-friendly description (ar):** استكشف كيف قد تمنع الأحكام غير العادلة على المصداقية سماع أصوات الناس.

##### التحقق من تأييد الأدلة عبر المصادر

[checkCorroborationAcrossSources.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/skills/checkCorroborationAcrossSources.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether apparently agreeing accounts are genuinely independent or reproduce one underlying report.

**User-friendly description (ar):** تحقق مما إذا كانت المصادر المتفقة تقدم أدلة مستقلة فعلًا.

##### التمييز بين الادعاء ودليله

[distinguishAClaimFromItsEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/skills/distinguishAClaimFromItsEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate what someone asserts from the observations, documents, or arguments presented to support it.

**User-friendly description (ar):** افصل بين ما يُقال وبين الأدلة المقدمة لدعمه.

##### التمييز بين الدليل المباشر والسماع المنقول

[distinguishDirectEvidenceFromHearsay.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/skills/distinguishDirectEvidenceFromHearsay.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize what a record or witness directly establishes and what depends on another person's retelling.

**User-friendly description (ar):** قيّم الشاهد أو الخبير وفق خبرته ذات الصلة وتعارض المصالح المحتمل.

##### مقارنة البحث الرصدي والبحث التجريبي

[compareObservationalAndExperimentalResearch.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/questionsAndHypotheses/skills/compareObservationalAndExperimentalResearch.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish observing variation as it occurs from deliberately manipulating an explanatory factor.

**User-friendly description (ar):** ميّز بين رصد التغير الطبيعي والتدخل عمدًا لتغيير عامل.

##### اشتقاق تنبؤ من فرضية

[deriveAPredictionFromAHypothesis.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/questionsAndHypotheses/skills/deriveAPredictionFromAHypothesis.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain what should be observed under specified conditions if a proposed explanation is correct.

**User-friendly description (ar):** توقع ما سيحدث في ظروف محددة إذا كانت الفرضية صحيحة.

##### التمييز بين الملاحظة والتفسير

[distinguishObservationFromInterpretation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/questionsAndHypotheses/skills/distinguishObservationFromInterpretation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate a recorded outcome from the theory-dependent explanation assigned to that outcome.

**User-friendly description (ar):** افصل بين ما سُجل فعلًا وكيفية تفسيره.

##### صياغة فرضية قابلة للاختبار

[formulateATestableHypothesis.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/questionsAndHypotheses/skills/formulateATestableHypothesis.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** State a possible answer whose empirical implications can be investigated rather than relying on an unfalsifiable restatement.

**User-friendly description (ar):** اقترح تفسيرًا يمكن اختباره بمقارنته بالملاحظات.

##### صياغة سؤال قابل للبحث التجريبي

[formulateAnEmpiricallyInvestigableQuestion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/questionsAndHypotheses/skills/formulateAnEmpiricallyInvestigableQuestion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify observations or comparisons that could bear on a precise research question, while recognizing questions outside empirical testing.

**User-friendly description (ar):** اطرح سؤالًا يمكن دراسته باستخدام أدلة ذات صلة.

#### النظريات والممارسة العلمية

Skills: 6

[theoriesAndScientificPractice.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/theoriesAndScientificPractice/theoriesAndScientificPractice.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Scientific conclusions are provisional but not arbitrary: shared procedures, criticism, reproducibility, and explanatory success distinguish responsible inquiry from mere assertion.

**User-friendly description (ar):** اكتشف كيف تتحسن النظريات العلمية بالنقد والأدلة الجديدة.

##### التمييز بين النظرية العلمية والفرضية

[distinguishAScientificTheoryFromAHypothesis.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/theoriesAndScientificPractice/skills/distinguishAScientificTheoryFromAHypothesis.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize a theory as a broad explanatory framework supported and refined through inquiry, not merely an untested guess.

**User-friendly description (ar):** ميّز بين نظرية علمية واسعة خضعت للاختبار وفرضية فردية.

##### تقييم مراجعة الأقران العلمية

[evaluateScientificPeerReview.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/theoriesAndScientificPractice/skills/evaluateScientificPeerReview.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish expert scrutiny of methods and interpretation from a guarantee that published claims are correct.

**User-friendly description (ar):** أدرك فوائد مراجعة الخبراء للعمل العلمي وحدودها.

##### تقييم قابلية الادعاء للتكذيب

[evaluateTheFalsifiabilityOfAClaim.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/theoriesAndScientificPractice/skills/evaluateTheFalsifiabilityOfAClaim.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess whether plausible observations could count against a proposition without treating falsifiability as the sole criterion of science.

**User-friendly description (ar):** تساءل أي ملاحظات يمكن أن تدحض ادعاءً علميًا.

##### شرح التصحيح الذاتي في العلم

[explainScientificSelfCorrection.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/theoriesAndScientificPractice/skills/explainScientificSelfCorrection.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe how independent criticism and new evidence can revise established models, without equating uncertainty with lack of knowledge.

**User-friendly description (ar):** اشرح كيف يمكن للأدلة الجديدة أن تدفع العلم إلى مراجعة استنتاجات سابقة.

**User-friendly description (ar):** افهم لماذا تساعد إعادة إجراء البحث على التحقق من النتائج.

[identifyConflictsOfInterestInResearch.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/theoriesAndScientificPractice/skills/identifyConflictsOfInterestInResearch.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize relationships that may create incentives to bias design, interpretation, or publication without assuming misconduct.

**User-friendly description (ar):** لاحظ العلاقات التي قد تؤثر في إجراء الباحثين للدراسة أو عرض نتائجها.

### الفلسفة الاجتماعية والسياسية

Groups: 6 · Skills: 23

[socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Political and social philosophy examines the justification of collective rules, institutions, authority, rights, and distributions of benefits and burdens. It asks normative questions rather than describing the chronology of regimes or the mechanics of markets.

**User-friendly description (ar):** افحص الأسس الأخلاقية للقوانين والحقوق والسلطة والقرارات الاجتماعية المشتركة.

#### العدالة والمساواة

Skills: 4

[justiceAndEquality.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/justiceAndEquality/justiceAndEquality.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Claims of fairness depend on what is distributed, who qualifies for consideration, and which differences are morally relevant.

**User-friendly description (ar):** استكشف كيف تؤثر مفاهيم الإنصاف المختلفة في ترتيبات المجتمع.

##### تحليل العدالة الإجرائية

[analyzeProceduralFairness.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/justiceAndEquality/skills/analyzeProceduralFairness.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess the transparency, consistency, and opportunity to contest a decision independent of who benefits from its outcome.

**User-friendly description (ar):** حدّد ما إذا كانت عملية اتخاذ القرار منصفة حتى عند الاختلاف حول نتيجتها.

##### مقارنة مبادئ التوزيع

[compareDistributivePrinciples.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/justiceAndEquality/skills/compareDistributivePrinciples.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate allocation by need, merit, equality, entitlement, or sufficiency and identify conflicts between principles.

**User-friendly description (ar):** قيّم ما إذا كان ينبغي توزيع الموارد حسب الحاجة أو الاستحقاق أو الحقوق أو المساواة.

##### التمييز بين المساواة والإنصاف

[distinguishEqualityFromEquity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/justiceAndEquality/skills/distinguishEqualityFromEquity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare giving identical treatment with responding to relevant differences in needs or disadvantage, without assuming one always settles justice.

**User-friendly description (ar):** قارن بين معاملة الجميع بالطريقة نفسها ومراعاة الفروق ذات الصلة.

[evaluateAClaimAboutDiscrimination.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/justiceAndEquality/skills/evaluateAClaimAboutDiscrimination.data.ts)

#### فلسفة القانون
